claims.exact_statement: For every finite Boolean address-row seed F_0(y,x)=sum_z chi_z(y)h_z(x) with exactly one nonzero sign row at each x and product normalized squared spectrum in each positive-mass row, multiplying row z by the quadratic bent sign B_{k_z} on 2k_z common fresh variables produces a genuine Boolean function with product conditional rows and exact identities H(F_k)=H(F_0)+2 sum_z alpha_z k_z and I(F_k)=I(F_0)+sum_z alpha_z k_z. For the A071 seed this gives H/I=(40+2L)/(17+L)<=40/17, L=5k_0+k_1+k_2+k_3.
hypotheses: exactly one nonzero partial sign row at every data input
each positive-mass normalized row squared spectrum is product
quadratic bent factors B_k on an even number 2k of fresh variables
proof_dependencies: B15-A071 finite 40/17 seed at open-problems commit 5aca95345e9eaef015d406af6f84bf74c5a3e01d
refutes: row-wise quadratic bent amplification of the A071 seed can increase H/I above 40/17
claims.first_unproved_line: Arbitrary {0,plus-or-minus-1} product-spectrum rows, including general non-fair product marginals, remain unclassified.
